intro: After Lack of Surplus, Tok'Kar begins work on your weapon and tells you to speak with Katar in the Swamp of Sorrows. Katar has said patrols along the beach could use some help.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While I begin work on your weapon, why don't you talk to Katar? He mentioned needing help with patrols along the beach, and I'd rather see you keep your wits and weapons prepared instead of getting drunk with some of the other louses I share this camp with.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Be silent a moment, adventurer. Even over the dull roar of the sea you can still hear those disgusting gurgles from the fish men.
